title: Messaging — Mux Admin List — payload
description: An administrator lists the stored mux grants of a principal DID, of a member DID, or between the two, a page at a time, without their signed statements. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

principal.description: Only grants delegated to this principal DID. At least one of `principal` and `member` is REQUIRED.

member.description: Only grants on this member DID; the response then carries the member's current `epoch`. At least one of `principal` and `member` is REQUIRED.

cursor.description: An opaque continuation token from a previous response's `nextCursor`, bound to the requester and the other request members; a responder MUST NOT accept a cursor it did not issue.

limit.description: The most grants to return, at most 500; the responder chooses a default (100) and MAY return fewer.

AdminGrantView.title: AdminGrantView
AdminGrantView.description: An administrator's view of one stored grant: what it delegates, to whom, in what state and until when. Unlike GrantView, never the signed statement — that goes only to the grant's two parties, through messaging/mux/list.

principal.description: The principal DID the grant delegates to.

scope.description: The effective scope: the signed scope, or the narrower one messaging/mux/update set.

expiresAt.description: The effective expiry: the signed `exp` rendered as RFC 3339, or the earlier one messaging/mux/update set.

epoch.description: The member DID's epoch the grant was signed under. A grant whose epoch is earlier than the member's current one is dead (`epochRevoked`).

signedAt.description: The statement's signed `iat`, rendered as RFC 3339.

narrowed.description: True when messaging/mux/update narrowed the effective scope or expiry below what the statement signs.

Response.title: Messaging — Mux Admin List — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a messaging/mux/admin-list request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/messaging/mux/admin-list/0.1#response.

grants.description: Grants in every state, active and dead ones still within the retention window, ordered by member DID, then principal DID, then grant identifier.

epoch.description: Present exactly when the request named `member`: that member DID's current epoch, which messaging/mux/admin-revoke-all names to advance it.

nextCursor.description: Continuation token for the next page; pass it back as `cursor`. Absent on the last page — never `null`.
